comments.author: @schow2020
comments.text: Anyone watching this video should file a complaint with YouTube for misinformation. This video does not accurately represent Cambodia as a whole. Cambodian women do not build huts to find husbands; this may have been a practice among a small ethnic group in the past, but it is not representative of the broader culture. Furthermore, you cannot rent a wife in Cambodia; if you are referring to sex workers, that is a different context altogether. It's also incorrect to say that there are Cambodians living in graveyards; that situation involved only a small population and occurred a long time ago.

replies.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
replies.text: 🤔 Good point—the difference between “some communities” and “Cambodia as a whole” really matters. What else felt misleading?
